tt:7708044129753648417.creator: viralex.aii
tt:7708044129753648417.caption: AI video editor in Claude Code: 3 free prompts, from an empty folder to a finished reel. #claudecode #videoediting #aitools #reels #claude SETUP (once) 1. Get the Claude app (claude.ai/download) and open the Code tab, not the browser. 2. Make a folder "AI Editor" with 3 folders inside: raw, references, done. 3. New chat in Code, choose Local, select the AI Editor folder. Needs a paid Claude plan. Runs on a computer, not a phone. PROMPT 1: TOOLS You're my video editor. We work in this folder: raw, references, done. Install and verify 5 tools: FFmpeg with libass (on Mac: ffmpeg-full, full path), faster-whisper for word-level subtitles, yt-dlp for references, Remotion, HyperFrames (npm package hyperframes). Check what's installed first. Official installs only (Homebrew, winget, npm/pip), Node.js 22+. Python packages go in a .venv here: pip install faster-whisper "av<19". Test each for real: burn a subtitle into a test clip, transcribe 5 seconds of audio. Show a table: tool, version, works or not. PROMPT 2: YOUR TASTE Here are reels whose editing I like: [link 1] [link 2] [link 3]. My format: [talking to camera / voiceover]. Download them with yt-dlp into references (for study only). Study each one frame by frame and by ear: pacing, shot length, pause cuts, subtitles, colors, graphics, transitions, music, the first 3 seconds. Take inspiration, but don't copy: no shots, text, logos or brand elements. Write my own style to style.md with exact values. Show it to me. PROMPT 3: EDIT My new recording is in raw. Edit it using style.md: 1. Transcribe with Whisper, word timestamps. Ask me about doubtful words before burning subtitles. 2. Cut pauses, slips and bad takes, keep the last good take. Keep pauses that serve the meaning. Don't speed up my voice. 3. Word-by-word subtitles in my style. 4. If references/music.mp3 exists, put it quietly under the voice. 5. Graphics only where they help. 6. Export 1080x1920 to done as draft-v1.mp4 plus edit-notes.md. Check the file, then show me. Save my fixes as draft-v2, draft-v3. No code words - everything's right here. Follow arti.miller for a free Claude setup like this every day.

tt:7711364201389772039.creator: aitips.nepali
tt:7711364201389772039.caption: Claude AI video editing नेपालीमा: तपाईंहरूले मागेको पूरा prompt 👇 📌 Save गर्नुहोस् ✅ चाहिने: Claude desktop app (browser होइन, claude.ai/download) → Code tab, एउटा "AI Video Editor" folder (भित्र Raw Footage, Exports), आफ्नो raw video 1️⃣ Tools install (पहिलो पटक मात्र) Install FFmpeg, HyperFrames and Whisper (whisper.cpp) and test each one. Skip anything already installed. If something fails, fix it and tell me. Tell me when you're ready. 2️⃣ Raw video → reel Edit the video in Raw Footage into a 9:16 reel (1080x1920, 30fps). 1. Transcribe with Whisper. Cut mistakes, repeats, long pauses and moments where I look away or touch my face. 2. Punch-in zoom (110-120%) on important sentences, zoom out on the next, so the frame changes every 2-4s. 3. Word-by-word captions, lower middle. Keyword of each line bigger and yellow. Spell words exactly as I say them. 4. When I list points, show a numbered badge (1, 2, 3) with a short title. 5. When I say something drawable ("layers", "growth", "market"), cut to a 2-3s motion graphic. 6. Light music under my voice, small SFX on zooms, badges and graphics. 7. How to set up your own AI video editor in Claude

I post almost every day and I just don't have time to edit, so I built my own AI video editor. Here's the full setup, step by step. Save this so you can do it later.

Step 1, get Claude and make 3 folders: you need at least the Pro plan (the free one doesn't work). Make a folder for your AI video editor with 3 folders inside: Raw Footage, References and Exports.

Step 2, install the tools: Remotion, HyperFrames, FFmpeg and Whisper (I also use yt-dlp to pull reference videos). Then tell Claude:
"Be my Instagram video creator. Install these tools, test each one and tell me when you're ready."

Step 3, teach it your style: put 3 to 5 Reels from creators you like into the References folder (I put in about 10). Tell Claude to study the fonts, the colours, the captions and how they overlay video. It will come back with a mood board.

Step 4, drop in your raw clip: put your footage in Raw Footage and tell Claude to add titles, captions and hashtags, and to show you a storyboard before it exports.

Step 5, prompt, review, redraft: how you prompt it and how you change the prompt is the most important part. Expect 3 to 4 drafts before you get something you like. It took me 2 hours to nail my style, and I'm still teaching it new things every day.

There are a lot of videos on this online, but this is the most realistic one. Now go set it up yourself.
